parole.significato: a suffix used to create colloquial shortenings, usually consisting of the first syllable of the word + -ó (these can be…

Perhaps derived from English -o. Also compare Swedish -o o

parole.significato: fax, telefax (document sent electronically and printed with a fax machine)

parole.significato: a cool, tough guy, a dude

parole.significato: coke (Coca-Cola or a similar soft drink)

Borrowed from English nice, from Old French nice, from Latin nescius (“unaware, ignorant”).

parole.significato: shire (administrative division in Britain and Australia)
snap; crack (a loud sound from hitting something)

to snap (to lose control of oneself due to anger)
